sentences.en: There's a place in South Dakota, just off Interstate 90.
sentences.zh: 在南达科他州，90号州际公路旁有一个地方。

sentences.en: That's one of those tourist attractions that you see hundreds of signs for as you approach.
sentences.zh: 那是你在接近时会看到数百个路标的旅游景点之一。

sentences.en: They count down the miles and list the reasons to stop in.
sentences.zh: 它们会倒数里程，并列出你应该停车进去看看的理由。

sentences.en: Cowboy boots, donuts, cheap coffee, 60 miles ahead.
sentences.zh: 牛仔靴、甜甜圈、廉价咖啡，前方60英里。

sentences.en: Souvenirs, fun for the whole family.
That's reporter Phil Corbett from a podcast called The Wind.
sentences.zh: 那是来自播客《风》的记者菲尔·科比特。

sentences.en: And a few months ago, while driving across the wide-stretching grasslands of South Dakota,
sentences.zh: 几个月前，当我开车穿越南达科他州广袤的草原时，

sentences.en: I aimed the wheel off the freeway and followed the signs to the ultimate roadside stop, Wall Drug.
sentences.zh: 我把车开离了高速公路，顺着路标来到了终极路边停靠站——沃尔药店（Wall Drug）。

sentences.en: We are a fun roadside attraction.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个有趣的路边景点。

sentences.en: We're a slice of Americana, you know.
sentences.zh: 我们是美国文化的一角，你知道的。

sentences.en: Sarah owns Wall Drug with her dad, and she is the fourth generation of Husted to run this place.
sentences.zh: 莎拉和她父亲共同拥有沃尔药店，她是经营这家店的第四代赫斯特家族成员。

sentences.en: It's in the small town of Wall, South Dakota, which sits right at the spot where the Badlands crumple up.
sentences.zh: 它位于南达科他州沃尔这个小镇，正好坐落在荒地（Badlands）隆起的地方。

sentences.en: Above, the Great Plains silently sprawl toward a distant horizon.
sentences.zh: 上方，大平原静静地向遥远的地平线延伸。

sentences.en: Sarah's great-grandfather bought this place as a simple small-town pharmacy during the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 莎拉的曾祖父在大萧条时期买下了这个地方，当时它只是一家普通的小镇药店。

sentences.en: And over nine decades, the family expanded this small drugstore to take up an entire city block.
sentences.zh: 在九十年的时间里，这个家族将这家小药店扩建到了占据整个街区。

sentences.en: And in addition to its restaurant, soda fountain, donut shop, and traveler's chapel, it is a remarkable purveyor of western kitsch.
sentences.zh: 除了餐厅、汽水吧、甜甜圈店和旅行者礼拜堂外，它还是西部媚俗艺术的杰出供应商。

sentences.en: And that is why I stopped.
Not for the cheap coffee, but because Wall Drug is synonymous with one of my favorite examples of western kitsch.
sentences.zh: 不是为了廉价咖啡，而是因为沃尔药店是我最喜欢的西部媚俗艺术典范的代名词。

sentences.en: We are looking at a full wall of jackalopes.
sentences.zh: 我们现在看到的是整整一面墙的“杰克兔”（jackalope）。

sentences.en: Looks like we've sold some here, but we have four rows of solid jackalopes.
sentences.zh: 看起来我们这儿卖掉了一些，但我们还有四排实打实的杰克兔标本。

sentences.en: And they have their nice wood plaques and the beautiful jackrabbits with the real antlers.
sentences.zh: 它们有漂亮的木质底板，还有长着真鹿角的漂亮野兔。

sentences.en: If you're not familiar with the jackalope, this magical, mythical creature is a horned rabbit.
sentences.zh: 如果你不熟悉杰克兔，这种神奇的、神话般的生物就是一种长角的兔子。

sentences.en: And though I've seen many lone-mounted jackalope heads, I am struck by the variety, seeing them side by side in rows.
sentences.zh: 虽然我见过很多单独装裱的杰克兔头，但看到它们一排排并列在一起，我还是被这种多样性震撼了。

sentences.en: I think his lips are kind of pursed and he's looking quite perky here.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它的嘴唇有点撅着，看起来很有精神。

sentences.en: I would call this guy a little more wiry.
sentences.zh: 我会说这个家伙看起来更精瘦一点。

sentences.en: And then you have the nice kind of more wintry jackalopes that are nice and white, super fluffy.
sentences.zh: 然后还有那种更像冬天的杰克兔，又白又蓬松。

sentences.en: And I think those ones are extra cute.
The antlers are of different sizes and shapes.
sentences.zh: 鹿角的大小和形状各不相同。

sentences.en: The rabbits all have different expressions.
sentences.zh: 兔子们的表情也各不相同。

sentences.en: Some wry and knowing, others calm and wide-eyed.
sentences.zh: 有的带着揶揄和了然，有的则平静而睁大眼睛。

sentences.en: But all of them with a certain straight-faced charm.
sentences.zh: 但它们都有一种一本正经的魅力。

sentences.en: For the past 70 years, Wall Drug has been central in the spread of this iconic creature.
sentences.zh: 在过去的70年里，沃尔药店一直是传播这种标志性生物的核心。

sentences.en: I wouldn't want to say Wall Drug is responsible.
sentences.zh: 我不想说沃尔药店负有全部责任。

sentences.en: I wouldn't want to get too big of a head.
But we do see a ton of people from all over come through.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实看到成千上万来自各地的人经过这里。

sentences.en: And here is probably the first time that they're seeing the jackalope.
sentences.zh: 而这很可能是他们第一次见到杰克兔。

sentences.en: But the story of how the jackalope became a mythical mascot of the American West, inspiring an absolute river of trinkets and songs and whiskeys and postcards and tall tales,
sentences.zh: 但关于杰克兔如何成为美国西部神话吉祥物，并激发了源源不断的饰品、歌曲、威士忌、明信片和民间传说，

sentences.en: that story goes back much further than Wall Drug.
sentences.zh: 那个故事要比沃尔药店的历史久远得多。

sentences.en: The way most people encounter the jackalope is not in the wild, but instead, on a wall.
sentences.zh: 大多数人遇到杰克兔的方式不是在野外，而是在墙上。

sentences.en: Yeah, a pool hall, a bar, a greasy spoon diner, and maybe your grandfather's basement.
sentences.zh: 没错，台球厅、酒吧、廉价餐馆，或许还有你祖父的地下室。

sentences.en: This is Michael Branch, who wrote a book called On the Trail of the Jackalope.
sentences.zh: 这是迈克尔·布兰奇，他写了一本名为《追踪杰克兔》的书。

sentences.en: He spent years driving around the American West, talking to everyone who knew anything about jackalopes,
sentences.zh: 他花了几年时间开车环游美国西部，与所有了解杰克兔的人交谈，

sentences.en: in a quest to understand where this creature came from and why it stuck around for so long.
sentences.zh: 试图弄清楚这种生物从何而来，以及为什么它能存在这么久。

sentences.en: According to Mike, the first documented taxidermy jackalope was made by two young brothers in the early 1930s.
sentences.zh: 据迈克说，第一个有据可查的杰克兔标本是由两兄弟在20世纪30年代初制作的。

sentences.en: Ralph and Doug Herrick lived on a little homestead outside of a tiny town called Douglas, Wyoming, out on the edge of the prairie.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫和道格·赫里克住在怀俄明州道格拉斯小镇外的一个小宅基地上，就在草原边缘。

sentences.en: And those kids had been taking a taxidermy course as a correspondence course through the mail.
sentences.zh: 那两个孩子当时正在通过邮寄函授课程学习动物标本制作。

sentences.en: Like many Depression-era families, the young Herricks hunted and fished to help stock the family dinner table.
sentences.zh: 像许多大萧条时期的家庭一样，赫里克家的孩子们通过打猎和捕鱼来补贴家用。

sentences.en: And they had been out hunting one day, and they'd bagged a jackrabbit.
sentences.zh: 有一天他们出去打猎，捕到了一只野兔。

sentences.en: They came back and threw it on the floor of their shop.
sentences.zh: 他们回来后把它扔在店里的地板上。

sentences.en: And as the story goes, it slid up against some deer antlers from a deer that had been dressed out not long before.
sentences.zh: 故事是这样说的，它滑到了几根鹿角旁边，那是刚处理完不久的一头鹿留下的。

sentences.en: I'm not totally understanding the physics of this scene, but it's okay.
sentences.zh: 我不太理解这个场景的物理原理，但没关系。

sentences.en: And that gave them the idea in that moment when they saw that weird hybrid thing sitting on the floor of their shop.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，当他们看到那个奇怪的混合体躺在店里地板上时，他们有了灵感。

sentences.en: And that was the first jackalope head mounted on a plaque.
sentences.zh: 于是，第一个装在底板上的杰克兔头就诞生了。

sentences.en: This was the hoax mount that started it all.
sentences.zh: 这就是开启一切的恶作剧标本。

sentences.en: These two kids taking a taxidermy class through the mail apparently did a pretty good job because they brought the mount down to the local pub where the bar owner paid them 10 bucks for it.
sentences.zh: 这两个通过函授学习标本制作的孩子显然做得相当不错，因为他们把标本带到当地酒吧时，老板花了10美元买下了它。

sentences.en: And that particular first jackalope hung in the old Labonte Hotel in Douglas, Wyoming, over the bar from the 1930s all the way through the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 那个最初的杰克兔标本从20世纪30年代一直到70年代，一直挂在怀俄明州道格拉斯的老拉邦特酒店的吧台上方。

sentences.en: And that was the rock that got thrown in the pond.
sentences.zh: 那就是投入池塘的那块石头。

sentences.en: And the jackalope ripples went out from there across the country and across the whole world, really.
sentences.zh: 杰克兔的涟漪从那里扩散开来，传遍了全国，甚至传遍了全世界。

sentences.en: The Herrick brothers kept making these things, and they probably would have remained just a local Wyoming oddity if not for Waldrug,
sentences.zh: 赫里克兄弟继续制作这些东西，如果不是因为沃尔药店，它们可能只会是怀俄明州当地的一个怪谈，

sentences.en: which has been selling jackalopes for at least 70 years.
sentences.zh: 而沃尔药店至少已经卖了70年的杰克兔了。

sentences.en: The reason Waldrug is such a vital part of the story of the jackalope is that it was probably the first place that ever commercially sold jackalopes,
sentences.zh: 沃尔药店之所以在杰克兔的故事中如此重要，是因为它很可能是第一个商业化销售杰克兔的地方，

sentences.en: and they have never stopped since.
sentences.zh: 而且从那以后就从未停止过。

sentences.en: Long before the internet, Waldrug helped the jackalope go viral.
sentences.zh: 在互联网出现很久之前，沃尔药店就帮助杰克兔实现了“病毒式传播”。

sentences.en: Tourists and road trippers from all over the world would stop in at this roadside emporium and see, on the wall, this rabbit with antlers.
sentences.zh: 来自世界各地的游客和公路旅行者会停在这个路边商场，看到墙上那只长角的兔子。

sentences.en: As more people came into contact with the antlered rabbit, a torrent of tall tales followed.
sentences.zh: 随着越来越多的人接触到这种长角的兔子，随之而来的是如潮水般的民间传说。

sentences.en: An elaborate mythology sprung up around the creature dreamed up by many different storytellers.
sentences.zh: 围绕着这种生物，许多不同的讲故事的人构思出了一套复杂的神秘学。

sentences.en: No corporation or person is entitled to control its distribution, its consumption, its interpretation.
sentences.zh: 没有任何公司或个人有权控制它的分发、消费或解读。

sentences.en: It is truly part of the folk process.
sentences.zh: 它确实是民间创作过程的一部分。

sentences.en: According to jackalope lore, the creatures are smart and considerably dangerous.
sentences.zh: 根据杰克兔的传说，这种生物很聪明，而且相当危险。

sentences.en: They only mate during lightning storMs.
And if you put out a bowl of whiskey at night, a passing jackalope may finish it off.
sentences.zh: 如果你晚上放一碗威士忌，路过的杰克兔可能会把它喝光。

sentences.en: And in his drunken bravado, he'll believe he can catch bullets in his teeth, which is the only way hunters can manage to bag them.
sentences.zh: 酒壮怂人胆，它会以为自己能用牙齿接住子弹，而这正是猎人捕获它们的唯一方法。

sentences.en: Also, jackalope milk is supposedly a powerful aphrodisiac.
sentences.zh: 此外，据说杰克兔奶是一种强效的催情剂。

sentences.en: And even though the jackalope sleeps on its back, it's incredibly dangerous to milk one.
sentences.zh: 尽管杰克兔是仰卧睡觉的，但挤它的奶极其危险。

sentences.en: And finally, the jackalope is the only animal that can throw its voice like a ventriloquiSt.
sentences.zh: 最后，杰克兔是唯一能像腹语术士一样投射声音的动物。

sentences.en: If you're out camping and you sing around the campfire, you'll hear that voice coming in from the sage of the jackalope harmonizing with you.
sentences.zh: 如果你在露营，在篝火旁唱歌，你会听到从鼠尾草丛中传来杰克兔的声音，与你和声。

sentences.en: Throughout history, people have told stories about chimera.
sentences.zh: 纵观历史，人们一直在讲述关于奇美拉（嵌合体）的故事。

sentences.en: The original chimera, from Greek mythology, was a fire-breathing monster with a lion's head, a goat's body, and a serpent's tail.
sentences.zh: 最初的奇美拉来自希腊神话，是一个喷火的怪物，长着狮头、羊身和蛇尾。

sentences.en: Over time, the word has come to mean any hybrid creature made up of different animal parts.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这个词演变成了指代任何由不同动物部位组成的混合生物。

sentences.en: Horses with wings, cats with eagle heads, fish with fur.
sentences.zh: 长翅膀的马、长着鹰头的猫、长毛的鱼。

sentences.en: When inventing something new, the oldest trick in the book is to smash two existing things together.
sentences.zh: 在发明新事物时，最古老的技巧就是把两个现有的东西拼凑在一起。

sentences.en: But the jackalope chimera distinctly fits into the American WeSt.
sentences.zh: 但杰克兔这种奇美拉明显地融入了美国西部。

sentences.en: And it emerged at a particular moment in the West's history.
sentences.zh: 它出现在西部历史的一个特定时刻。

sentences.en: Early in the country's Western colonization, frontiersmen and settlers were often seen from the East as bumpkins, uncultured and immoral people living in a wild land.
sentences.zh: 在美国西部殖民早期，边疆开拓者和定居者在东方人眼中往往被视为乡巴佬，是生活在蛮荒之地的粗俗且不道德的人。

sentences.en: But going into the 1900s, pop culture started to romanticize the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 但进入20世纪，流行文化开始浪漫化西部。

sentences.en: People loved stories about heroic cowboys living on the prairie, the stuff that you'd see in Buffalo Bill's Wild West show.
sentences.zh: 人们喜欢关于生活在草原上的英雄牛仔的故事，就像你在布法罗·比尔的“狂野西部”表演中看到的那样。

sentences.en: Over time, the diverse and complicated reality of the West was slowly flattened into a simpler and more whitewashed myth.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，西部多元而复杂的现实被慢慢抹平，变成了一个更简单、更美化的神话。

sentences.en: Part of that romantic retelling included an interest in the actual Western tradition of tall tales.
sentences.zh: 这种浪漫化的重述中，包括了对真实的西部民间传说传统的兴趣。

sentences.en: That language of hyperbole, of exaggeration, of larger than life.
sentences.zh: 那种夸张、渲染、超乎寻常的语言。

sentences.en: So that's part of what we associate with the American West, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们与美国西部联系在一起的一部分，对吧？

sentences.en: Is this wonderful tradition of extravagant folk humor.
sentences.zh: 这就是那种奇妙的、夸张的民间幽默传统。

sentences.en: Settlers as early as the mid-1800s used humor and embellishment to subvert the narrative that they were ignorant.
sentences.zh: 早在19世纪中期，定居者们就利用幽默和修饰来颠覆他们是无知之辈的叙事。

sentences.en: I think the tension between the East and West in the United States from the 19th century forward is a really important part of the story.
sentences.zh: 我认为从19世纪开始，美国东西部之间的张力是这个故事中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, people in the American West who maybe are seen as frontiersmen or bumpkins or uneducated,
sentences.zh: 你知道，美国西部的人可能被视为边疆开拓者、乡巴佬或没受过教育的人，

sentences.en: they say, oh yeah, well, guess what?
sentences.zh: 他们会说，哦，是吗，好吧，猜猜怎么着？

sentences.en: I know more than you do about something and it's this.
sentences.zh: 在某件事上我知道的比你多，就是这个。

sentences.en: I'm going to fool you with this jackalope.
sentences.zh: 我要用这只杰克兔来愚弄你。

sentences.en: There's a great satisfaction in taking someone who is condescending or a lead
sentences.zh: 戏弄那些居高临下或自以为是的人，

sentences.en: and exposing their ignorance when they're busy trying to expose yours.
sentences.zh: 并在他们忙着揭露你的无知时揭露他们的无知，这有一种巨大的满足感。

sentences.en: Some of the jackalope's allure is that it sets up this ruse.
sentences.zh: 杰克兔的部分魅力在于它设下了这个骗局。

sentences.en: There are people who know and people who don't.
sentences.zh: 有知道真相的人，也有不知道的人。

sentences.en: And a lot of the satisfaction comes from playing with that line.
sentences.zh: 而大部分满足感来自于在这一界限上玩弄。

sentences.en: Telling people a long, just barely plausible story,
sentences.zh: 给人们讲一个漫长、勉强可信的故事，

sentences.en: all the while pointing to the evidence right there on the wall.
Like all good humorists, the jackalope always keeps a straight face.
sentences.zh: 像所有优秀的幽默家一样，杰克兔总是保持着一本正经的表情。

sentences.en: It refuses to acknowledge that it's funny in any way.
sentences.zh: 它拒绝承认自己有任何滑稽之处。
它把自己看得非常严肃。

sentences.en: But there's a curious thing about horned rabbits.
sentences.zh: 但关于长角兔子有一件奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: While we know the origin story of the jackalope,
sentences.zh: 虽然我们知道杰克兔的起源故事，

sentences.en: there are illustrations and descriptions of this specific creature going back much, much further.
sentences.zh: 但关于这种特定生物的插图和描述可以追溯到更久远以前。

sentences.en: For instance, there's a Renaissance illustration of a squirrel and three rabbits,
sentences.zh: 例如，有一幅文艺复兴时期的插图，画着一只松鼠和三只兔子，

sentences.en: the central one sporting a crown of antlers.
sentences.zh: 中间那只头上戴着鹿角冠。

sentences.en: Or there's a Flemish painting from the 17th century
sentences.zh: 或者有一幅17世纪的佛兰德斯画作，

sentences.en: that shows a wreath of fruit and flowers surrounded by birds, deer,
sentences.zh: 画中展示了一个由水果和花朵组成的花环，周围环绕着鸟类、鹿，
还有一只长角的小兔子。

sentences.en: And this is not just in Europe.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅是在欧洲。

sentences.en: Horned rabbits show up all over the world.
sentences.zh: 长角兔子出现在世界各地。

sentences.en: Indigenous people from Mexico and the Americas,
sentences.zh: 来自墨西哥和美洲的原住民，

sentences.en: there are horned rabbit tales in the folklore of many African peoples,
sentences.zh: 许多非洲民族的民间传说中也有长角兔子的故事，

sentences.en: certainly all across Europe, and then in Asia.
sentences.zh: 当然还有整个欧洲，以及亚洲。

sentences.en: A horned rabbit is even invoked in early Buddhist texts
sentences.zh: 长角兔子甚至在早期的佛教文献中被提及，

sentences.en: as a way to talk about the very nature of reality.
sentences.zh: 作为谈论现实本质的一种方式。

sentences.en: Basically, the Buddha says to his students,
sentences.zh: 基本上，佛陀对他的学生说，

sentences.en: If you think a horned rabbit exists,
sentences.zh: 如果你认为长角兔子存在，

sentences.en: then you don't understand anything about the world or about human consciousness
sentences.zh: 那么你对世界或人类意识一无所知，
因为显然它是不存在的。

sentences.en: And then he'd ask his students to picture a horned rabbit.
sentences.zh: 然后他会要求学生想象一只长角兔子。

sentences.en: Well, the horned rabbit is real to you now, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在长角兔子对你来说是真实的，不是吗？

sentences.en: So if you think the horned rabbit doesn't exist,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你认为长角兔子不存在，

sentences.en: you don't know anything about reality or the nature of the mind.
sentences.zh: 那你对现实或心灵的本质一无所知。
